title: No internal or prestige jargon in outward copy
rationale: Outward copy keeps the depth but drops the jargon: a prospective volunteer with no background must both understand the line and want it. Removed jargon comes back unless a check pins it.
fix: Use the plain replacement listed in config/outward-terms.json, or plain words a newcomer would understand.

patterns.message: Internal or prestige term in outward copy.
